description: Stacking ensemble with a LogisticRegression meta-model trained on group-out-of-fold (OOF) base-learner margins. Base learners are LogisticRegression and LinearSVC; meta-features are their 6-dimensional decision margins per fold. No group leakage: meta-model never sees in-sample base predictions.
feature_representation: fold-local word unigram/bigram TF-IDF margins (6 features: LR 3-class + LinearSVC 3-class decision scores)
oof_construction: 3 fixed group folds; base models trained on 2 folds, predict on held-out fold
artifact_note: No separate fitted artifact is saved. Stacking OOF features and validation predictions are canonical outputs. Production release is models/releases/linear-svc-primary-v2/.
